The text exhibits classic characteristics of the fantasy genre, specifically high or epic fantasy. It features a dramatic, apocalyptic setting ("fiery landscape," "crimson and ash"), a clear antagonist force ("the Scourge"), and a protagonist facing an existential threat ("battle for their very existence"). The language is descriptive and elevated, focusing on world-building and narrative tension rather than factual reporting or technical instruction.

Regarding the priority question embedded in the content: The empire ruled by Julius Caesar was the Roman Empire.
